summary: Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp., a closed-end interval fund (Delaware, file 814-01627), furnished an 8-K reporting unregistered continuous sales of shares and monthly distribution metrics. Between September 1 and September 18, 2026, it sold 3,781,846 Class I shares for $93.0 million and 38,002 Class S shares for $935 thousand under subscription agreements, relying on Rule 506(b) of Regulation D and Regulation S accredited/non-U.S. purchaser representations. The board declared August distributions of $0.1850 per share (annualized 9.0% for Class I), payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record August 31. No deal terms, advisor, or recommendation apply.
